question: Which of the following is the time period of the Tenth Five Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002-2007**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007) was the first Five-Year Plan of the 21st century. It was launched by the Government of India in 2002 and aimed to achieve several key objectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The plan focused on achieving 8% annual GDP growth.
 
• It emphasized agriculture, infrastructure development, and education as priority sectors.
 
• The plan aimed to reduce poverty by 10 percentage points and increase employment opportunities.
 
• It introduced the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) to provide employment to rural households.
 
• The plan also focused on improving the health of the population and increasing access to healthcare services.
 
• It aimed to achieve universal literacy and improve the quality of education at all levels.
 
• The plan was successful in achieving most of its objectives and laid the foundation for subsequent Five-Year Plans.
